consequence.statement: Operators that do not set the flag get a higher default Cilium Operator K8s client rate limit of 100 QPS/200 Burst, which may increase load on the Kubernetes API server.
consequence.remediation: Set --operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst (or the corresponding Helm values) to keep a different rate limit.

assertion.statement: The Cilium Operator's Kubernetes client rate limit is now configured separately from the agent's, and its default rose to 100 QPS/200 Burst (flags --operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst).
